items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: When Shorty, my first husband, was with Tommy Dorsey they had baseball games.

ctx.x: And he started with Shorty Sherock’s little orchestra. So then he got, you know, his dream came true, he got to work with Basie too. A lot of wonderful people went through that band.
And for a short time he had a small group too. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -3-
